name: Mondelez Global R&D Innovation Center - Whippany NJ
type: R&D / global innovation center (office + lab, pilot & scale-up lines)

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (40.8198,-74.4179) were an approximate Route 10 / Whippany centroid ~700m WNW of the real building. Resolved via web research to 941/945 State Route 10 (the former Cadbury 'Channel Building', a ~148-150k sq ft former Cadbury Adams candy/gum lab) and confirmed via satellite. Locked center 40.8200,-74.4097.
fieldNotes.facilityType: This is a corporate R&D / global innovation center - office + lab, NOT a freight plant. ~150,000 sq ft, ~$50M repurposed Cadbury R&D building, opened May 2023, houses ~50 R&D makers/bakers plus pilot and scale-up lines for cookies, crackers and candy. Freight relevance is LOW: it consumes small material shipments, not a distribution operation.
fieldNotes.layout: Satellite (z19-z20) shows a long L-shaped low-rise building with rooftop HVAC, ringed by car/employee parking and a large ground-mount solar array on the SW lot (consistent with Mondelez electric-baking / net-zero messaging). No dock apron, no trailer parking, no dock-door bank visible.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open office-park driveway off Route 10 with no barrier, no guard booth - false. Street View from inside the lot shows landscaped employee parking and a flagpole, no controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: No loading-dock bank. Classified NONE; dockDoorCount set to 1 as a conservative allowance for a single small service/materials door typical of an R&D building - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Suburban Morris County office/commercial corridor on Route 10 with dense surrounding residential and retail - classified Urban.

verification.rationale: 17-whippany-nj** — Mondelez Global R&D Innovation Center (941/945 State Route 10, Whippany NJ 07981) — REJECTED: NON-FREIGHT R&D. No yard to audit per the rubric. [Tier 1: https://ir.mondelezinternational.com/news-releases/news-release-details/mondelez-international-opens-doors-new-global-rd-innovation, 2023-05]
